name: multi-file-audit
description: Audit all tool implementations in Sources/Yrden/Tools/ for path validation patterns. Uses glob to discover files, read_file to inspect each tool, and write_file to produce an audit report.
task: Audit all tool implementations in Sources/Yrden/Tools/ for path validation patterns. Use the glob tool to find all .swift files in that directory, then read each tool file (ReadFileTool.swift, WriteFileTool.swift, EditFileTool.swift, GlobTool.swift, GrepTool.swift, ShellTool.swift) to check which tools have a pathValidator property and how they use it (e.g., calling validateRead or validateWrite). Write a markdown audit report to audit.md in the working directory listing each tool, whether it has a pathValidator, and which validation methods it calls.
